title: CARD GAME CORE — RULES v0.5 (20 Nov 2026)

rows.Decision / Rule: Comedy-fantasy gacha card battle; no compulsory main storyline or Main Quest
rows.Implementation Notes: MVP loop Gacha → Team/Deck → Battle → Rewards → Upgrade

rows.Decision / Rule: Fights as an actual character/sprite on field; Action cards command units
rows.Implementation Notes: Never treat avatar cards as Action deck consumables

rows.Decision / Rule: 4 Avatars per player team
rows.Implementation Notes: Can bring mixed factions

rows.Decision / Rule: Win all enemies defeated; lose all 4 own avatars defeated
rows.Implementation Notes: Handle simultaneous deaths explicitly

rows.Decision / Rule: ATK / DEF / SPD
rows.Implementation Notes: Migrate old POW and legacy stats safely

rows.Decision / Rule: Higher team SPD takes first turn, then alternating sides
rows.Implementation Notes: Team aggregate and tie resolution remain PENDING

rows.Decision / Rule: 5 base AP, reset at beginning of each own turn
rows.Implementation Notes: No auto end turn at AP 0

rows.Decision / Rule: Each Action Card cost is card data, allowed 0 to 5 AP
rows.Implementation Notes: Do not assume cost for unassigned individual cards

rows.Decision / Rule: 30 Action Cards in deck
rows.Implementation Notes: Duplicate limit per card still PENDING

rows.Decision / Rule: 5 cards
rows.Implementation Notes: Start of battle

rows.Decision / Rule: Retain unplayed cards; draw until 5 at start of own turn
rows.Implementation Notes: If draw deck empty, shuffle Discard to Draw

rows.Decision / Rule: Extra draw during turn may temporarily exceed five
rows.Implementation Notes: Card effect decides extra draw

rows.Decision / Rule: Discard excess freely until hand ≤ 5 at end of round
rows.Implementation Notes: Discard UI is required

rows.Decision / Rule: Optional discard during own turn costs 1 AP per card
rows.Implementation Notes: No AP cost for mandatory end-of-round discard

rows.Decision / Rule: Player explicitly presses End Turn
rows.Implementation Notes: Never auto End Turn when no AP

rows.Decision / Rule: Normal played Action moves to Discard Pile
rows.Implementation Notes: Except specific Void effects

rows.Decision / Rule: When Draw empties, shuffle only Discard into Draw
rows.Implementation Notes: Void never auto-recycles

rows.Decision / Rule: Active pile for cards exiled by effects; viewable any time
rows.Implementation Notes: Supersedes v0.4 legacy status

rows.Decision / Rule: Some named card effects retrieve specified cards from Discard/Void
rows.Implementation Notes: Destination per effect; no global return rule

rows.Decision / Rule: ATK / DEF / Skill
rows.Implementation Notes: Action, not old Tactic

rows.Decision / Rule: Avatar Active fired using eligible Action Card (usually 1 Avatar per Action)
rows.Implementation Notes: Explicit card text can override one-target default

rows.Decision / Rule: Works with any eligible Avatar regardless of faction
rows.Implementation Notes: Deck not faction-exclusive

rows.Decision / Rule: Matching Faction Avatar required to activate, except card-specific override
rows.Implementation Notes: Check both deck mixed faction and play gate

rows.Decision / Rule: N / R / Epic / EX
rows.Implementation Notes: Supersedes five-rarity model

rows.Decision / Rule: N / R / Epic / EX / FAC; EX and FAC same top power tier
rows.Implementation Notes: FAC is action rarity/category, not avatar faction

rows.Decision / Rule: Only base stats; a few N have small Active
rows.Implementation Notes: No uniform active requirement

rows.Decision / Rule: Active OR Passive
rows.Implementation Notes: Not both by default

rows.Decision / Rule: Active + Passive
rows.Implementation Notes: All four example Avatars are Epic

rows.Decision / Rule: Active + Passive + Ultimate
rows.Implementation Notes: Activation conditions/data beyond this pending

rows.Decision / Rule: Maximum level 5; separate from Stars/Rank
rows.Implementation Notes: Keep Star cap PENDING

rows.Decision / Rule: Hero Synthesis for stars; Promotion Stones for rank promotion
rows.Implementation Notes: Quantities/material recipes PENDING

rows.Decision / Rule: Gifts and Relationship apply to Companions ONLY, not Avatars
rows.Implementation Notes: Separate character schema

rows.Decision / Rule: Common/Rare/Legendary/Mythic v0.4 values
rows.Implementation Notes: Do not use in new roster/gacha

rows.Decision / Rule: 10+10 Tactic, 7 MP, Valhalla, no Void
rows.Implementation Notes: Current Action deck=30, AP=5, Discard+Void

rows.Decision / Rule: Autonomous AI fight is not current primary battle system
rows.Implementation Notes: Current player-controlled turn-based

rows.Decision / Rule: Old Tactical 5×2 / front-back
rows.Implementation Notes: Do not hardwire until Owner confirms

rows.Decision / Rule: 100% initial Sync from old concept
rows.Implementation Notes: Lore/mode only until Owner confirms active stat

rows.Decision / Rule: Sum/Avg/Max and tie handling
rows.Implementation Notes: Keep configurable; avoid unapproved permanent rules

rows.Decision / Rule: Exact formulas, heal cap and KO behavior
rows.Implementation Notes: Test and present chosen temporary defaults separately

rows.Decision / Rule: Max duplicates in 30-card deck
rows.Implementation Notes: Do not carry v0.1 'no duplicates' forward

import_note: Verbatim import; values and Status strings unchanged. Numbers that were x.0 floats are stored as integers.
